title: Rain Sounds
status: concept-proposal (Creative Director, 2026-11-19; not approved; awaiting owner review)
hook_line: I sleep to rain sounds. Last night I paused them.
first_visual: A sleep-sounds app glowing on a nightstand; rain on the dark window behind it.

beats.visual: App on the nightstand; rain on the window; Ivy's eyes closing.
beats.vo: I sleep to rain sounds. Last night I paused them.

beats.visual: Thumb taps pause on the app.
The rain outside the window stops instantly, droplets frozen.
Exterior: Vesper Court in a dry night; one window streaming wet.
Ivy pauses again; the tapping continues, slower, like knuckles.
beats.vo: This time the tapping didn't stop.

beats.visual: App info screen: DURATION: LIVE. SOURCE: OUTSIDE YOUR WINDOW.
Key moment: a too-tall silhouette on the wet glass, long fingers tapping in rhythm; a moth on the frame.

ending: A too-tall silhouette on the wet glass, fingers tapping in the exact rhythm of the track.
loop_note: Yes. The opening rain sound is the same loop as the final tapping, so a rewatch re-hears the first second as fingers.

originality_review: Original. A sleep-sounds app as a cover for a live presence is our own premise. Generic app UI, no real brand. Low similarity to MW004 (voicemail): different device and twist.
scores_basis: Initial editorial judgement, 2026-11-19. topic_demand is an estimate linked to research/WEEKLY_TREND_REPORT.md categories, not a measurement of this concept.
concept: Ivy falls asleep every night to a 'rain on window' track. Pausing it stops the real rain outside. It was never a recording. It is a live feed of something tapping on her window, and the app was covering for it.

hooks.line: I sleep to rain sounds. Last night I paused them.
hooks.first_visual: A sleep-sounds app glowing on a nightstand; rain on the dark window behind it.

hooks.line: When I pause the rain track, the rain outside stops.
hooks.first_visual: A thumb pausing a track; raindrops freeze mid-run on glass.
Exterior: one wet window on a dry building.

hooks.line: I paused it. The tapping didn't stop.
hooks.first_visual: A dark window, faint rhythmic taps.

setting: Ivy's bedroom; the sleep app; her window, the only wet window on the building.
conflict: Ivy tests the strange link between the track and the rain.
escalation: Play/pause controls the rain; only her window is wet; the tapping goes on with the track paused.
reveal: App info: Duration LIVE. Source: outside your window.
emotional_objective: Comfort ritual turned into violation (sleep gap G4).
